_comment: Canonical AskUserQuestion headers (12 characters or fewer). The capture hook maps a header, case-insensitively, onto its canonical name through aliases; an unknown header is still logged with header_known:false so distill can map it.

headers.name: Target app
headers.use_for: Which app or lib owns the change.

headers.name: Scope
headers.use_for: What is in or out of this change; follow-ups.

headers.name: Plan
headers.use_for: Approving a proposed plan before implementing.

headers.name: API contract
headers.use_for: Endpoint, schema or response shape in libs/api-contract.

headers.name: Tenancy
headers.use_for: School and campus isolation, roles, guards, who may see or do what.

headers.name: Test layer
headers.use_for: Which tests to write: unit, integration, e2e.

headers.name: Dependencies
headers.use_for: Adding a library versus reusing what exists.

headers.name: Performance
headers.use_for: Query cost, caching, bundle size, pagination.

headers.name: Root cause
headers.use_for: Diagnosing a bug; which explanation to act on.

headers.name: Commit/PR
headers.use_for: Commit grouping, PR split, branch, draft or ready.
